notes.title: Update on the current situation
notes.notes:
Hey all, Bauske here.



I'm posting this to give an update on Micro Stream RPG's current state. While it's not the good news I'd love to be giving right now, I want to be up front and honest about what's going on.



First, the good news: The third dungeon, which I've called The Jagged Vale, is basically done, and I've been starting work on the dungeon after that. Before I launched Micro Stream RPG, I had intended for the third dungeon to be a swamp area, and was already in the process of creating stage graphics and enemies for it. Due to progression ideas though, I felt like the swamp would work better as dungeon four, and started working on another area for dungeon three. Now that dungeon three is almost done, dungeon four should go much faster as I already have about half the assets ready to go. It's mostly just programming special situations and enemy stats from that point.



My goal for the next update is to have both dungeon three and four done to give you guys a bit more content to sink your teeth into. And then after that, I'm hoping to get the companion app launched too. That'll give you more customization options and control over your character and game progression.



Next, the not-so-good news: Progress has been slower than I would have liked. Much slower. There's a couple reasons for this. The main one is that I've been struggling with a couple major bugs in Micro Stream RPG. If you've read past news updates or the community posts here on Steam, you probably know some of what I'm been talking about. The three major issues right now in the game are:

Micro Stream RPG randomly crashing

Micro Stream RPG randomly disconnecting from chat and not receiving commands

Micro Stream RPG executing shortcut commands when the window is not in focus

I'll admit I'm a bit of a perfectionist at times, and these issues are pretty serious to me and I want them addressed. The problem has been that I can't seem to find solutions for them. I've been asking the Clickteam developers for assistance, I've been sharing test builds with people to get input on changes, and wracking my brain on solutions without much progress. It's made working on the game frustrating to say the least because whenever I want to work on new content, I'm reminded these bugs are present and I continue to try and fix them.



Now for the bad/maybe good? news: As it turns out, my copy of Clickteam Fusion, the program I created Micro Stream RPG in, was corrupt. I've had it installed on my computer ever since the most recent rebuild, which was a couple years ago, so I suppose it's not surprising, but I've never had Clickteam Fusion itself become corrupt. I didn't even think to consider this as a possible cause for the issues I've been having. But after experiencing some other weird, unexplained issues in both Micro Stream RPG development and other game development, I decided to completely uninstall and reinstall the program. My suspicions were correct, and it seems like the corruption and issues have been resolved... at least in the other games I was working on.



Here's the current bad news: The Micro Stream RPG files seem to be corrupt. What I mean by this is that I can open the files, edit and update them, but I cannot run them. The game simply does not execute. Nothing happens. And I'm not sure why. I suspect that the corruption in Clickteam Fusion affected the Micro Stream RPG core files a long while back (coincidentally, right around the time I launched on Steam), and none of my backup files up to that point will actually run in the fresh install of Clickteam Fusion.



What this means is I will have to completely rebuild Micro Stream RPG in a new project file in the hopes that the game will function again. No, this doesn't mean completely recoding the game. I just have to copy and paste all the coding, assets, and objects from the current files into a new project file and test to make sure it all is working. It's time consuming and tedious, but better than starting from scratch. I've done this before with a past project, so I'm fairly confident this will work, and my hope is that doing so will hopefully resolve the three big issues I mentioned above. I'm not 100% confident it will, but I'm hopeful.



So that's the skinny on the current situation. My apologies for the long post, but I wanted to explain what's been going on. It's been a frustrating past few weeks/months trying to fix these issues, all to culminate in a program corruption situation I wasn't expecting. I need to do the rebuild to continue work on Micro Stream RPG, BUT I'm hopeful that doing so will fix some of these other issues I've been struggling with. I'm trying to stay positive about all this haha.



If you read this far, thanks for sticking with me. For the TL;DR - Micro Stream RPG has had a few issues lately that I believe were caused by my copy of Clickteam Fusion going corrupt, and now I need to rebuild the game in a new project in order to continue development. It's not hard, just time consuming, but I'm hoping it'll fix the issues going forward.



Thank you again for your patience, and I'll update you all again once I get the rebuild done.



~Bauske

notes.title: Update Version 0.23
notes.notes:
Hey all, Bauske here. 



First off, I want to apologize for the lack of updates recently. Full transparency, between some life stuff and just general ADHD focus struggles, motivation to work on the game lately has been low. I try not to make excuses for productivity, but this happens from time to time with me and game development, and often I find the solution is to spend a little time with some other projects to help refresh and rebuild that motivation again. So even though I haven't been progressing on Micro Stream RPG as much as I'd like, I have been making progress, and having fun working on a couple other small things as well.



That said, this update is just a small one for now. I wanted to have the next dungeon done by now, but it still has a little more cooking left to do. Along with the new dungeon, I had a couple little fixes and additions I had made that I was planning to bundle all into the next update, but I'm going to split them for now so I can at least fix some of the things that have been bugging me about the last release.



I'm aware there are a couple persistent issues in the game currently. For one, sometimes the game crashes. This seems to happen when the game is communicating with Twitch to refresh your connection status and get a new OAuth code. Problem is it happens so infrequently and I'm having a hard time pinpointing it. Please bear with me on this, as I'm trying to figure out the cause of the crash and get it fixed. A second issue is that the game sometimes just stops responding to chat commands. I think I found the cause of this one, so hopefully that's fixed, but if you still experience issues here, please let me know. And the third one, which is the big one that forced this update, is that for some people, Micro Stream RPG seems to respond to keyboard shortcut commands even when the game is in the background. I've had a few people come to me with this issue, and again it's something I'm struggling to figure out because, unfortunately for myself, the issue doesn't occur on my computer, so I can't test and try to fix it.



I've put some coding into this version to once again hopefully fix this issue and prevent shortcut commands from activating when Micro Stream RPG isn't the app in focus, but I'm going to post a thread in the community discussions specifically for this issue. If you experience this, please note which game or program you had running at the time and what keyboard command seemed to cause issues for you. Hopefully with some outside help I can narrow down what might be causing this.



Okay, enough rambling. Thanks for your patience. Next dungeon is coming soon, I promise. For now, here are the changes for this version.



New Features: 

New character sprites - Added in unique characters sprites for users BeanyCoffee, retropony28, RodShark, and Felius_Nightfox.



Adjustments: 

Changed the shader on the sparkle graphic used when a badge is earned. Since this is a shader I'm not as familiar with, please let me know if you experience any issues with slowdown or performance when a badge shows up.

Changed the fullscreen key command to CTRL + F to help prevent the game going full screen sometimes when the game isn't in focus.

Implemented a secondary flag when a player ALT + Tabs to another program to hopefully prevent commands working in Micro Stream RPG when the game isn't in focus.

Made the magnifying glass on page 4 of the Settings Menu respond to keyboard and mouse selections to better indicate it is a selectable icon.

Added some coding to hopefully prevent an issue where menu shortcut commands would activate even when Micro Stream RPG was in the background.


Bug fixes:


Fixed an issue where certain shortcut commands (like pressing CTRL + X to lock dungeon access, or CTRL + 2 through 6 to change window size) outside of the Settings Menu wouldn't activate the commands until the Settings Menu was opened.

Fixed an issue where the notification icon for connection issues wasn't displaying properly in menus.

Fixed an issue where the first-time menu bar tutorial would appear on top of messages on screen if you skipped the tutorial on the first startup.

Fixed an issue with some of the background color remained black even when a different background color is selected.



V0.23.1 Changes: 

Disabled Shortcut commands temporarily due to an issue where they are activating even when the window isn't in focus. This is set off by default, but you can re-enable them by holding S + C + \\ for three seconds. You'll see a message pop up at the bottom of the screen to let you know Shortcuts are on. Hold the same three keys again for three seconds to deactivate the Shortcuts. I'm looking into this, but I'm not entirely certain still what's causing it to happen on some computers and not on others.


~Bauske

notes.title: Update Version 0.22
notes.notes:
Hey all, Bauske here. 



I hope everyone enjoyed the Spring Event! It was a lot of fun to put it all together, but even more fun seeing people enjoy their time collecting eggs. If you enjoyed it as well, then please know that other events are planned for the future of Micro Stream RPG. I'm excited to share more with you when the time comes!



For now, a small feature update to Micro Stream RPG. In this update, I've implemented a few new Settings menu options based on feedback from people in the community! Game development is an interesting process because no matter how much time you spend thinking of things to add in to your project, you're never going to think of some things until your game gets into the hands of others. These new options are much like that, and they give streamers more power over customizing Micro Stream RPG to fit their streaming environment. That, in my opinion, is always important, and I hope people enjoy using them.



As always, there are a few minor bug fixes as well in this version. And also as always, if you notice anything weird or out of place, please let me know either here or on the community discussion page so I can get it taken care of ASAP! Thanks as always to everyone's continued support of Micro Stream RPG. I'm hoping to get the next dungeon out within the next few days, so keep an eye out for that soon. For now, onto the update notes!



New features: 

A total of three new menu options have been added to the Settings menu to allow more customization of Micro Stream RPG.

Added the Queue Responses option to the Settings menu. This allows streamers to customize how often the game responds to people entering the queue in three ways: "Off" turns the messages off completely, "Some" operates how the game currently is with queue responses if the player is already in queue, and "All" gives every queue response, including when the queue is full and how many people are in queue when someone enters.

Added the Background Color option to the Settings menu. This allows the streamer to customize the black color of Micro Stream RPG for more customization.

Added the Edit Chat Responses option to the Settings menu. Clicking this will bring up a document of responses Micro Stream RPG will use when needed. You may edit and customize these however you wish. Detailed instructions are in the document itself.

Added in a Feedback and Suggestions section to the credits, with the names of people who have provided feedback or ideas that have been implemented into the game.

Added in a mouse hover feature to the Settings menu. When navigating the menu, moving your mouse over the options will highlight them, giving a better sense of navigation. I'm still a bit unsure about how much I like this, so any feedback on it will be welcomed. 


Bug fixes:


Fixed an issue where promo messages would display even when the dungeon was locked from entries.

Fixed an issue where bosses of normal dungeons couldn't be defeated if the player was max level.

Fixed an issue where sometimes the hidden eyes icon would stay present after a hidden enemy was defeated.

Fixed an issue where boss sprites would flash on screen or not be displayed properly when facing them in The End Between. 


~Bauske

notes.title: Update Version 0.21
notes.notes:
Hey all, Bauske here.

First off, I want to start by giving a HUGE thank you to everyone who has been playing and enjoying Micro Stream RPG. When I started this project, it was only meant to be a small toy for my own stream, but the more my viewers on Twitch enjoyed the game, the more I wondered if it was something that other people might enjoy using if it were made more public. Over the past week, I've had the chance to see that question in action, and I cannot tell you how happy it makes me to see viewers and streamers alike playing and enjoying the experience. I know it's just a small little game at the moment, but there's something special about seeing something you've made bring others happiness, and I really can't say thank you enough for that.

So THANK YOU! Thank you, sincerely. I told you I couldn't say it enough. <3

In case you missed it, the Spring Event started yesterday. I hope everyone gets to enjoy the event over the next couple weeks. It's the next step in the timeline of events I have planned. After the event, you can expect the next dungeon to be released, and shortly after that the Companion App. These will help inject some longevity to the game for a bit while I pump out the next bit of content.

I'm also aware there is an issue in the game that causes Micro Stream RPG to sometimes stop connecting to chat and receiving commands. I'm looking into this and hoping to have a solution to it here soon. In the meantime, if this issue does occur, just close Micro Stream RPG out and open it back up again. My apologies for this.

That about wraps up the immediate things I wanted to talk about. I'll be sharing more in the future as it develops. For now, here are the small changes/fixes made to this version.

New features:

Added in functionality to keep the queue counter on screen by pressing F1. You can toggle it back off with F1 again.


Adjustments:

Adjusted the healing amount from "!heal" commands when the game is set at 2x or 3x speed. This increased healing is put in place to help provide a little more oomf to heals on these speedier runs since the cooldown timer for "!heal" commands usually doesn't reset until after the run is over.
Adjusted the level cap for monsters in the Spring Event dungeon to never exceed the player's own level. This is mainly put into play to help low level players not get completely demolished by the event dungeon's enemies.
Adjusted the stats of some of the enemies in the Spring Event dungeon to make them slightly easier to deal with. We hate seeing people lose out on earning eggs.


Bug fixes:

Fixed an issue where eggs collected during the Spring Event would still register even if the player died during their run. This would sometimes allow them to skip over a badge milestone.
Fixed an issue with "!heal" commands not registering when the on-screen character is moving between monsters.
Fixed an issue where earning a badge other than the Spring Event Badge in the Spring Event dungeon would end the run prematurely.
Hopefully fixed an issue where sometimes a player who used the "!rpg" command would be placed into the Spring Event dungeon instead.


V0.21.1 Changes:


Reworked player and monster speed calculations through the engine to more consistently reflect speed differences across all level scaling.
Updated some of the dungeon title text graphics for consistency.
Sped up the "Turn-In Complete!" text at the end of a Spring Event run to better match the current game speed.
Hopefully fixed an issue where sometimes players using the "!rpg" command would instead be placed in the Spring Event dungeon.
Disabled Twitch "PING" detection as I think this might be causing some random crashes.
Fixed an issue preventing the Queue Limit function from working.
Fixed an issue where incorrect monster data was being recorded.


V0.21.2 Changes:


Fixed an issue with game color not working.


~Bauske

notes.title: Update Version 0.20
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here.

Well... it's finally time! Micro Stream RPG releases Friday, May 16th at 12:00 pm EST! It's been a journey getting here, and as this is my first official game launch as an indie dev, I'm both incredibly excited and a bit nervous! Let's go over a couple things you can expect with this update and the release of the game.

First, why Early Access? Instead of waiting until I had all the dungeons added that I wanted for release, I decided to release Micro Stream RPG a little earlier to get it into the hands of more people. For starters, this helps me gauge how the game is going to run at a larger scale, which I'm crossing my fingers everything will go smoothly. Releasing as Early Access also gives me the opportunity to gather feedback from anyone who plays it. Feedback to how the game works, what people like and what they don't, etc. will have a big impact on how the game evolves going forward. I can't promise I can make every request come true, but if it's a possibility and something people want, you can be sure I'll strive to make it happen.

Second, what does this mean for the full release? I still plan on more dungeons, more enemies, more of everything. Those are all in the works. Currently the game features two main dungeons and a hold-over dungeon, and the next three dungeons are already being fleshed out and worked on. The biggest reason I hadn't worked on them before was all the coding and systems I had to put in place to get Micro Stream RPG working how I wanted. This build should mark the completion of all the main systems of the game, so now I'm free to work on additional content.

Third, there's something fun planned for the game as well. More information on that next Friday, May 23rd. If you purchase or play the game, keep an eye out for that!

I'm also planning on keeping in the Special Beta Badge until the game comes out of early access, so if you have yet to hit level 15 in the game, you've still got time to earn this limited-time badge!

But for now, let's see how everything goes! I'm gonna say it. I've never done this before, especially with an online, sorta-live-servicey-style game, so this is all pretty new territory to me. I have no idea what release is going to look like, what kind of scope to expect, what kind of issues we may encounter, but I promise I'm going to be doing my best to make sure it goes as smoothly as possible, and I ask for your patience if there are any hiccups along the way. 

If you DO experience anything weird, any bugs, any crashes, anything that just seems odd, please let me know on the community boards, or by emailing me. The email address can be found on Micro Stream RPG's store page.

Okay with that all out of the way, let's get on to the changelog!

New features:


Added in functionality for events. Keep an eye out for these in the future!
Added in a short menu tutorial after the main tutorial to help introduce people on how to use the settings menu. This only appears the first time after the game is run and the main tutorial is finished.
Adjusted the game's speed down to normal during when a player finishes a dungeon or earns a badge to help highlight that player's achievement. The game will return to the speed set in the settings after the event finishes.


Adjustments:


Changed the wording in the menu from "Lock Abyss Entry" to "Dungeon Entry". This will hopefully make this function's purpose a little clearer.
Added total healing done to statistics.
Added in the badge sound effect when earning a normal dungeon badge.
Added in some protections to hopefully keep the game window from being placed outside the monitor space during screen resolution changes. This may not be perfect due to the sheer amount of multiple monitor configurations, but this will hopefully help the game window to not get lost outside monitor space. If you do experience the game starting but cannot find the game window, just press CTRL + W to recenter the game window at any time.
Spaced out the intro logo and the player badges at the beginning of each game so there's a little more space for the badges to breathe and be displayed.
Disabled backup data and settings restoration. This initially was put in place when Micro Stream RPG hosted all its data, including player progression, locally on the streamer's PC to prevent accidental wiping of player data. Since everything is hosted online now, there's not a huge need for this. If I can find a way to make it work in the future, I will restore it.


Bug fixes:


Fixed an issue where the wrong stage graphics would be displayed after running a connection test or replaying the tutorial from the Connection menu.
Fixed an issue where exporting statistics (CTRL + L) and exporting log files (enter the log with CTRL + E and press CTRL + S) would not export properly or at all.
Hopefully fixed an issue where sometimes when trying to refresh the streamer's chat authorization code the game would lock up and need to be restarted. If you experience the game regularly not connecting to chat or having to restart the game, please let me know.


V0.20.1 Changes:


Added in some coding to prevent the game window from accepting keyboard commands when Micro Stream RPG is not in focus.


V0.20.2 Changes:


Fixed an issue with the Rat King boss where the Rat Runt attacks were not timing properly.
Fixed an issue with the Beehoof boss where the bee enemy sprites were not showing up properly.


V0.20.3 Changes:


Updated the coded to prevent the window from going outside the monitor space again. Hopefully this will keep it from doing so in the future.
Added in some attempted error logging in case any crashes happen in the future.
Added in commands for the streamer and moderators to lock or unlock the game from receiving entries. These commands are "!lockrpg" and "!unlockrpg".


~Bauske

notes.title: Beta Update Version 0.19
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here.

Last update I mentioned it "should" be the last update before release. That was the plan, but apparently with all the new Twitch integration coding, I messed some stuff up. Some of the beta testers were telling me they were having trouble connecting, or the Connection menu itself was soft-locking when trying to connect. Those are... not good things, and needed to be fixed before I could move forward. This update really shouldn't have taken as long as it did to do, but once again it involved a lot of back end programming and updating.

I also had a couple testers express some confusion on how to operate the menus in game, and understandably so. All the necessary sections are there, but they could be a lot clearer in how to use them. My plan was to have website/Discord documentation for all the menus and how to use them (and I still intend to do this), but having help outside the game isn't necessarily a helpful or good idea. Moving forward, I'm going to be trying to find ways to make the menus and options in game easier to navigate, and hopefully clear up as much confusion as I can. This will be a work in progress, and I'll be reaching out to current testers to get their feedback on what I can improve. Hopefully when the game launches, I'll be able to gather feedback from a wider selection of people, and that'll make it ever better.

That's about it for this update. Nothing really explicitly new, just a lot of back end and connection improvements. Hopefully this will be the last time I need to focus on this. Hopefully.

New features:


Added dynamic pop ups in the Connection menu for error notifications.
Implemented a Twitch username validation system to ensure handles used for Channel Names and Chat Usernames are valid, active Twitch handles. This new username check is present in both the Connection menu and the Tutorial.
Added a PING response to Twitch chats so the game disconnects less frequently.


Adjustments:


Changed some sound effects when choosing menu options.
Simplified and reduced connection clutter from the in-game chat log. You can access the chat log at any time by pressing CTRL + E. Press CTRL + E again to close it.


Bug fixes:


Fixed an issue with the Connection menu soft-locking the game when clicking the GET button.
Fixed an issue where the game might not reconnect to chat after an OAuth token needs to be refreshed.


~Bauske

notes.title: Beta Update Version 0.18
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here.

I know I've been quiet in regards to updates lately, but I've been making good progress on Micro Stream RPG over these past couple months, despite the hiccups. Version 0.18 brings about a lot of updates and changes, primarily in the main game engine and a lot of mechanical or background stuff, so a lot of it may not be apparent when playing normally. For example, there aren't any new dungeons in this update (those'll be saved for the release), but there are some tweaks and new additions to attack animations. Things like that.

It's been a lot of set up lately, and a lot of prep and getting the main engine finalized for release. Additionally, I had to totally rework how the game connects to Twitch due to Twitch removing some OAuth connections. The bad news was this HAD to be done or any future users wouldn't be able to connect to Twitch. The good news is that, after a few weeks of learning and figuring the new connection configurations out, the game feels much more professional when it comes to authenticating with Twitch. I would say this is the biggest and most major part of this update, so if you experience any issues with your Twitch connection, please let me know.

Outside of that, we've got some new characters, some new weapons, and a few other tweaks as well.

Barring any other major changes from Twitch, this should be the final update before release. Now I'm going to focus entirely on new enemies and dungeons so I can get the game launched ASAP. I already feel way farther behind than I want to be!

Thank you all for being patient with me! Trust me, I'm just as excited to get this game launched as you are!

New features:


Added a new attack animation for ranged attack weapons.
Added three new default characters: A ninja, a barbarian, and a sorceress.
Added three new weapons: A bow and arrow, a hammer, and a spellbook.
Added an outline to both player characters and weapons to help them stand out from background graphics more.
Implemented Weapon Proficiency damage boosts. The only enemies this affects right now are the Tortimagus and the Manaquin. More on this later.


Adjustments:


Reworked connectivity to Twitch. This had to be done due to a Twitch security change. If you're a beta tester, your current OAuth token should still work, but if not, please use the Connection menu to reconnect to Twitch.
Changed backup data saving so that it only saves if changes have been made.
Changed the menu hover to only activate and show the menu bar if Micro Stream RPG is the focused window.
Adjusted Weapon Point rates. After looking at results from the beta test, the rate at which points were earned was skewed too high, causing levels to be higher than I would like for the time involved.
Changed the character's melee attack animations to be more impactful visually and more variable for the future. This also now allows attack animations to scale with the game's speed.
Normalized audio levels across all sound effects so the game isn't so loud.
Changed the sound effect when earning a medal.
Adjusted the poison rate of the Snake from 80 to 25. I want it to poison often, but not that often.


~Bauske

notes.title: Beta Update Version 0.17
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here.

My apologies for the lack of updates lately. Life stuff, stress, and general ADHD hurdles have had me scatterbrained over these past few weeks, but I've been trying to work on Micro Stream RPG when life allows. Progress has been slower than I'd like (I planned to have the game released by the start of Autumn), but the game is progressing. I'm working on new dungeons, new enemies, and gearing up for a release here hopefully in the next couple months. 

Not too much in this update that's gonna really stand out to users or players, but some good backend things to hopefully make the game run as smooth as possible in the future. The biggest one is the database check. For some background info, the online database has a feature that can put the game in standby mode if there's some emergency or maintenance need. Beforehand, the game was pinging a database check at the start of every player's run to see if the database was locked or not, and I noticed it seemed to be having a negative effect. When I watched the game in action on streams, there appeared to be a big lag between players typing the "!rpg" command and their run starting. So I've changed it so the game only pings for database updates once every 10 minutes. I might adjust this in the future to an even lengthier time between checks, as hopefully this isn't even a feature that's necessary very often, but for now this should help the game run smoother.

That's the biggest change. Please let me know if the game runs better or (hopefully not) worse in the future. Sincerely. I love feedback, and player and tester feedback is always valuable! As for the rest of the changes, you can read about them below! Thanks again for playtesting Micro Stream RPG! Here's hoping for a launch soon, I'm very excited about it!

New features:


 Added a version check function. Going forward, Micro Stream RPG will check it's version against the online database to make sure the game is on the most recent version. If not, users will need to update the game to continue playing.
 Added in a fourth layer of parallax scrolling for the background to help give more visual depth to the areas.
 Added in functionality for "!heal" and "bauskeheal" (my own personal emote for healing) to be read anywhere in a chat message instead of specifically at the beginning. Now users can use the emote or command anywhere in their chat replies and the game will recognize them.
 New character sprites - Added in unique characters sprites for beta testers FoxThiefBran, AlexArcher_, and AnsuBlue.


Adjustments:


 Adjusted the database status check to only check once every 10 minutes instead of before each player starts. This will hopefully lessen any lag in starting a player's game.


~Bauske

notes.title: Beta Update Version 0.15
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here.

Beta testing for Micro Stream RPG is still going strong, and there haven't been any major issues... yet. Maybe we're about to change that with this next update! We'll see!

Let's get into it. I mentioned in the last update that the next big phase of development was going to be getting an online database up and running in order to host user data. This means no matter where a person plays from, they'll keep their level, stats, badges, etc. Honestly I figured this would take me a while to get implemented, but I managed to get it going in just a couple weeks! That's the good news!

The "less good" news is that I can only test so much of this stuff on my own. As I've mentioned before, most of this is new to me, so I'm not sure how much strain my coding or the game itself is going to cause on the web hosting I'm currently using. That's where the beta testers come in! During this next phase of the beta test, I'm going to be monitoring how the online database functions are working and making sure everything is going smoothly, but I'm going to need feedback too. If you're one of the people beta testing the game, or if you're in their stream and notice any issues with your character data not recording properly, please let me know ASAP. You can do so by commenting here, or by emailing me at bauske@neon-lion.com.

That said, here are the streamers who will have Micro Stream RPG running on their channels during this beta test. Please feel free to check them out, and give them a follow too! They're all great streamers, and I appreciate all their help and support!

One last thing to mention before I get to the short patch notes. During this beta period, any player who manages to get to level 15 will earn the Special Beta Badge. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899898/61a5e59e0c675785a51e849d8f3f087b1ac24c79.gif

That about covers it! Thanks for reading. Here's the list of adjustments and bug fixes I've made for the current version of the game.

New features:


 New online database system! Player data is now hosted in an online database, meaning players can continue their progression across any stream they play Micro Stream RPG in.
 Added a limited-time Special Beta Badge for people to earn during this beta period. If a player can hit level 15 before the game launches officially, they'll earn the Special Beta Badge.
 Added a Max Level Badge. This can be earned by hitting the max level at any point. Currently during the beta the max level is 30, but this will increase in the future.
 New character sprites - Added in unique characters sprites for beta testers DEBT, KnightLycan, and Outcast_Stars.


Adjustments:


 Adjusted how the connection message pop ups appear to reduce their frequency when quick chat reconnects happen.
 Very slightly reduced enemy defense and hit point multipliers.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't connect to Twitch chat after the first tutorial or subsequent Twitch info setups if the user had skipped the tutorial the first time.
 Fixed an issue where the shortcuts to change screen size wouldn't work if the settings menu wasn't on the right page.


~Bauske

notes.title: Beta Update Version 0.13
notes.notes:
Hey all! Bauske here. This is my first post on Steam for Micro Stream RPG, so I thought I'd give an update on the current build and status of the game.

The Micro Stream RPG beta test has gone amazingly well so far, and I'm happy to say that there haven't really been any major issues to date. Most of the issues are minor visual bugs or adjustments to things to make the game feel better, but nothing that leads to a locked up game, forced reset, or even a *gasp* crash. That's awesome, and I couldn't be happier!

This means the majority of the engine work is done. The next steps involve creating more enemies, more bosses, and more dungeons. Those will be easy enough to get done, but the next real major thing I want to work on before the full release of the game is an online database system for storing user data. Currently in the beta, user data is store locally on the streamer's computer. What this means is that a user's data does not carry over from stream to stream, so if a user were to visit another streamer using Micro Stream RPG, they'd have to start their adventure all over again.

While initially I thought this would be an okay concept, I'm seeing from the beta that people would prefer to have their character data be accessible anywhere on Twitch. And I agree. This is the next step I want to take, but it's not the type of coding or feature I have much experience in, so it's going to take some time to learn and set up. Hopefully not too long. I'm still shooting for a late summer release timeframe.

That's about it for the major plans. Now, here's a list of adjustments and bug fixes I've made for the current version of the game.

New features:

 Window size hotkeys - Pressing CTRL + 2-6 at any time will scale the window size to 2x-6x size without having to go to the settings menu.
 Fire numbers - Some enemies are flammable. When a fire-casting weapon is used against them, it does bonus damage, which is now represented by a fiery effect behind the damage numbers.
 New character sprites - A couple new character sprites added in for some of the beta testers.
 Abyss lock message - A message will now be posted to chat when the streamer locks or unlocks the Abyss from the menu. This is to help make the lock functionality more seen by people in chat.


Adjustments:

 Sped up the intro sequence when a user starts a run.
 Changed the promo text to say "!RPG to start" instead of "!playMSRPG to start".


Bug fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the Rat King's minions (cordially known as Rat Runts) or the two other slimes in the Slime Stack wouldn't appear during the Layer 1 boss battles.
 Fixed an issue with the Leshy boss in Layer 2 not being hit by magic weapons while in the Hidden state.
 Fixed an issue with magic weapons not being assigned their elemental type.
 Fixed an issue with some of the background graphics displaying incorrectly when a dungeon is completed.


That should be all for now. Thanks for reading, and thank you to everyone supporting Micro Stream RPG! It means the world to me! 

~Bauske
